svg.title: GP1 starter tree
svg.desc: A sequence named one_cell, an orange box on the left, with lines to seven gray ellipses stacked from top to bottom: submit_report, wait_for_beam, pick_from_conveyor, place_on_tester, read_voltage, pick_from_tester and place_in_slot. A column of numbered tags on the right gives each leaf a number, top to bottom: 1, 2, 3, 3, 2, 3, 3.
